reviewNotes:
Allô Père Noël lets a parent prepare a pretend phone call from Santa for their child. Everything is simulated inside the app: it never places or receives real calls, never uses CallKit, the microphone or the network (except the App Store purchase).

How to test: tap "Prepare a magic call", type a first name (for example Emma or Liam; the letter says whether Santa has recorded that name), pick up to two qualities, tap Continue, keep "The magic call" and "Now", then tap "Start the call". An in-app incoming call screen rings; tap Answer. Santa appears full screen: it is an AI-generated portrait (FLUX.1 schnell, not a real person), and his mouth follows the sound of his voice.

Santa's voice. In all six languages (English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese) it is pre-recorded synthetic speech bundled in the app (not a real person's voice): every fixed line, plus a greeting for each common first name. If the first name is not one of the recorded ones, Santa simply greets the child without saying it. In every language, the words typed by the parent (a proud moment of the year, the Christmas wish; Christmas Pass only) are read by "Santa's elf" with the device's built-in speech synthesis at its natural pitch. Santa pauses so the child can answer (nothing is listened to or recorded), shows a star surprise and says goodbye. The end screen offers Replay, Create a keepsake (a card image shared with the iOS share sheet; photo access is only requested if the parent chooses Save Image) and Back to home.

Camera (optional, off by default). On the "Choose the story" screen, the parent can turn on "Show your child in a corner, like a video call"; iOS then asks for camera access. During the call the front camera is shown live in a small rounded window, as in a video call: no video or audio is recorded and nothing is transmitted. With the Christmas Pass the parent can also turn on "Keep their reaction in photos": up to six still frames are taken silently at key moments (the greeting, the laughs, the star surprise, the goodbye) and kept in memory only. After the call they are shown to the parent, who can save them to Photos or share them with the iOS share sheet; otherwise they are discarded. If camera access is refused, the call works exactly as before. The camera cannot be tried in the iOS Simulator.

Purchases, all behind a multiplication question for grown-ups, including before the privacy-policy link. Free tier: a preview of the magic call (greeting, age, qualities, a first question, goodbye; about 45 seconds), Santa's voice sample, and advent door 1. Christmas Pass (com.padelup.allonoel.pass, 6.99 EUR, non-consumable) unlocks the full calls, every story, calls for siblings, the elf's lines, the star surprise, the letter, the good-child certificate and the advent calendar. The earlier product com.padelup.allonoel.magie still unlocks the same Pass. Extra messages (com.padelup.allonoel.messages, 2.99 EUR, consumable) adds three shareable messages for another child. Open the Pass from the end of the preview, a locked story, the home screen or Settings. Restore is on the paywall and in Settings.

No account, no ads, no tracking, no data collection: the children's first names and details stay on the device and can be erased in Settings. The background melody is "Silent Night" (Franz Gruber, 1818, public domain), synthesized for the app. The font Fraunces is under the SIL Open Font License.
